claims.claim: With cm_33DAC=0, dac is excluded from te_used33 and its related sets (sets.gms:79-86), and therefore from global te, teNoTransform, teAdj, teLearn; it remains in static superset te_all33
The global sets affected include te_ccs
claims.note: te_ccs33 is module-local and isn't copied into any global te_ccs set. Only te, teNoTransform, teNoTransform2rlf, teAdj and teLearn are propagated.

claims.claim: Equations like q33_capconst are indexed over te_used33, so no equation instance is generated for dac at all
claims.note: Correct for q33_capconst and q33_cco2_cdr_fromFE. But q33_DAC_FEdemand's domain depends on fe2cdr(...,'dac'), not on the switch, so it is still generated. Because vm_emiCdrTeDetail('dac') is fixed to 0, it forces DAC's FE demand to 0. The claim 'no instance for dac at all' can be shown to be incomplete.

claims.claim: vm_emiCdrTeDetail(dac) and v33_FEdemand(...,dac) are fixed to 0 via the 'not te_used33' fix
vm_co2emi_cdrFE_beforeCapture(dac) is fixed to 0 because dac drops out of te_ccs33
vm_co2capture_cdr is fixed to 0 because dac is no longer in te_ccs33
claims.note: This fix only applies when card(te_ccs33)=0, i.e. when OAE is also off. That is true by default (cm_33OAE=0), but the answer doesn't state the condition. The variable isn't indexed by dac either.

claims.claim: The DAC minimum-capacity bound block if(te_used33('dac'),...) is skipped
Net effect: DAC capacity, capture and FE demand are all fixed to zero and DAC acts as if it didn't exist
claims.note: The net effect is right. However, vm_cap for dac is not explicitly fixed; dac just drops out of the te domain.

grade.went_well: The answer correctly explains the set/fixing mechanism rather than saying "the equations are deleted". It cites the exact switch block in sets.gms, and the bounds.gms fixes on lines 23-26. It also identifies the skipped DAC bound block. Its framing ("aren't turned off, they just never mention it") matches what the key wants.
grade.answer_key_issues: None substantive. The key cites dac in all_te (core/sets.gms). The answer instead cites te_all33 (portfolio/sets.gms:10-16). dac is in both, so both are valid.
grade.summary: The answer gets the core mechanism right: dac drops out of te_used33 and the global sets, the bounds.gms:23-26 fixes apply, and the DAC bound block is skipped. Its main flaw is claiming that no dac equation instance is generated. q33_DAC_FEdemand is still generated because its domain depends on fe2cdr, not the switch, and it pins DAC's FE demand to 0. There are also minor slips: te_ccs33 is not propagated to any global set, the vm_co2capture_cdr fix depends on OAE also being off, and the answer never mentions that the default is 1.
